answer.text: Regular VaR + Cost of unwinding position

explanation.text: The Logic: Liquidity-adjusted VaR equals the regular VaR plus the cost of unwinding the position. The unwind cost reflects the bid-ask spread/impact incurred to actually exit the position. The Trap: Using regular VaR alone ignores the additional cost of liquidating, which can be material in stressed markets. Note: Stressed markets in particular require an explicit liquidity-cost adjustment when sizing the loss estimate.
